case_title: PARK SANG SOO et al VS BAJALIA MARWAN et al

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY PARK SANG SOO WONG ROBERT YURK TO AS TO DEFENDANT BAJALIA MARWAN KELLER RICHARD ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR SEP-26-1994 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 08
